actions.name: spellcasting
actions.desc: The archmage is an 18th-level spellcaster. Its spellcasting ability is Intelligence (spell save DC 17, +9 to hit with spell attacks). The archmage can cast [[/item .A3q2gTNqG6fvNGrv]]{disguise self} and [[/item .1N8dDMMgZ1h1YJ3B]]{invisibility} at will and has the following wizard spells prepared: Cantrips (at will): [[/item .EOmsUcFQJTfG2oio]]{fire bolt}, [[/item .Bnn9Nzajixvow9xi]]{light}, [[/item .Utk1OQRwYkMkFRD3]]{mage hand}, [[/item .udsLtG0BugXHR2JQ]]{prestidigitation}, [[/item .XvbiNhNqXXIFisIy]]{shocking grasp} 1st level (4 slots): [[/item .ghXTfe7sgCbgf1Q8]]{detect magic}, [[/item .3OZnNhunvRtPOQmH]]{identify}, [[/item .CKZTpZlxj7hjjo2H]]{mage armor}*, [[/item .41JIhpDyM9Anm7cs]]{magic missile} 2nd level (3 slots): [[/item .ppWAAEul0QHtm4er]]{detect thoughts}, [[/item .X4c8xCkmF8U9HUMz]]{mirror image}, [[/item .wqfAVANuQonNBgnL]]{misty step} 3rd level (3 slots): [[/item .Ek45cBpVXvJdv1Qy]]{counterspell},[[/item .yfbK8gZqESlaoY5t]]{fly}, [[/item .IyikgTEOTv701jgQ]]{lightning bolt} 4th level (3 slots): [[/item .pxpb2eOB6bv4phAf]]{banishment}, [[/item .avD5XUtkBPQQR97c]]{fire shield}, [[/item .ReMbjfeOKoSj3O79]]{stoneskin}* 5th level (3 slots): [[/item .RpKjTlYASrfqUPVA]]{cone of cold}, [[/item .fVbCxFRaORalHB20]]{scrying}, [[/item .o9ZCvuD2B1OTcubb]]{wall of force} 6th level (1 slot): [[/item .WmQpxfjZwF3MGUby]]{globe of invulnerability} 7th level (1 slot): [[/item .L4J89JXqbKs6puEV]]{teleport} 8th level (1 slot): [[/item .bllEWfm9xfEKynhv]]{mind blank}* 9th level (1 slot): [[/item .JYuRBwxpoFhXduvD]]{time stop}* *-The archmage casts these spells on itself before combat.
